dataset: CultureGraph — Tamil Nadu Famous Instruments and Music by District (starter)
note: Districts list the instruments, music forms, dances and festivals in the current data that are associated with that district. Statewide traditions are listed separately.

statewide_traditions.name: Nadaswaram and thavil
statewide_traditions.why_famous: The nadaswaram and thavil ensemble plays at temples, weddings and processions across the state.

statewide_traditions.name: Panchavadyam
statewide_traditions.why_famous: A temple ensemble of five instruments, used in processions and festivals.

statewide_traditions.name: Karakattam
statewide_traditions.why_famous: A folk dance performed with a decorated pot on the head, linked to rain and harvest festivals across Tamil Nadu.

statewide_traditions.name: Kummi
statewide_traditions.why_famous: A women's clap-and-circle folk dance performed in villages during festivals.

statewide_traditions.name: Kolattam
statewide_traditions.why_famous: A stick dance performed in rhythmic patterns, often during festivals.

statewide_traditions.name: Oyilattam
statewide_traditions.why_famous: A village group dance with rhythm and song, performed at festivals and gatherings.

statewide_traditions.name: Villupattu
statewide_traditions.why_famous: A storytelling tradition in which a musical bow is played while singing, with regional roots in southern Tamil Nadu.

statewide_traditions.name: Therukoothu
statewide_traditions.why_famous: Street theatre with music, dance and dialogue, performed in villages during festivals.

statewide_traditions.name: Kanjira
statewide_traditions.why_famous: A small frame drum widely used in Carnatic music and performances across the state.

music_and_instruments.name: Chennai Music Season (December)
music_and_instruments.why_famous: An annual season of concerts in Chennai, one of the largest Carnatic music gatherings in the world.

music_and_instruments.name: Gaana music
music_and_instruments.why_famous: A folk-based music style from north Chennai, known for its lyrics about everyday life and popular among working-class audiences.

music_and_instruments.name: Parai drum
music_and_instruments.why_famous: A traditional drum used in folk festivals and community ceremonies in Tamil Nadu, with strong roots in the Chennai region.

music_and_instruments.name: Thiruvaiyaru Thyagaraja Aradhana
music_and_instruments.why_famous: Annual music festival held at Thiruvaiyaru in honour of the composer Thyagaraja, where Carnatic musicians gather to perform his compositions.

music_and_instruments.name: Tanjore Quartet
music_and_instruments.why_famous: A historic Bharatanatyam and music tradition from Thanjavur, known for its influence on dance and music styles.

music_and_instruments.name: Tanjore Veena tradition
music_and_instruments.why_famous: A regional school of the veena, associated with Thanjavur's court patronage and well known in Carnatic music.

music_and_instruments.name: Mridangam making in Thanjavur
music_and_instruments.why_famous: Thanjavur is a centre of mridangam (double-headed drum) craft, with families making instruments for performers.
